title: Vita Cheerleader Duo
description: Two stylized female characters in matching black and yellow cheerleader outfits with 'VITA' text on their tops. The left figure stands with hands crossed above her head beneath a large yellow starburst graphic, while the right figure poses with fists raised in a fighting stance. Both wear cropped tops, shorts with belts, striped arm warmers, and platform boots.
prompt: Two anime-style female characters with bright yellow hair in high ponytails, wearing coordinated black and yellow cheerleader outfits with 'VITA' lettering across the chest, black shorts with yellow belts, platform combat boots, and fingerless gloves.
